LanguageData.MS_Craft_ProductionNotice: Interrupted work can resume. Products default to network storage, with overflow near the core. Each order can instead drop products near its workbench.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_DropProductsOnFloorDesc: Place all finished products beside the worker at the current workbench, without attempting network storage. Changing this option does not interrupt work and also applies to the current iteration.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_BatchInvalid: This iteration cannot continue; delete the order to return remaining ingredients
LanguageData.MS_Craft_OpenDesc: Manage recipes, ingredients and workers for connected cosmic workbenches.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_TestNotice: Assignment test: ingredients are reserved but never consumed. Workers keep working with normal need interruptions. No products, repeat decrements or skill experience.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_Satisfied: No repeats remaining, target met or waiting to resume
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NoWorker: No eligible worker with the work type enabled
LanguageData.MS_Craft_AlsoCountsHint: Selected items also count toward the target, one per item, across the map and this core's network. The recipe product, "{0}", always counts under the order's existing count conditions, regardless of selections here. Nothing is selected by default.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NamedWorkerHint: As in vanilla, a named worker ignores this range. The recipe's minimum skill requirements still apply.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_LimitStuff: Count only products made of allowed ingredients
